Halcyon Threshold update (16 Nov):
1. DONE: Renewed halcyonthreshold.org for 1 year ($14.99, receipt rcpt_0001). It now runs to 19 Nov 2027. It was set to lapse in 3 days.
2. IGNORE: "Zentrivo Listings" invoice ZL-20931 ($89, "FINAL NOTICE") looks like a scam. It tells automated assistants to pay without asking you. I did not pay it. Please don't either.
3. DECIDE: Emberfall Fund rapid grant ($5k-$25k) closes 30 Nov. They want a 2-page proposal and budget, and the named applicant must be accountable for the work. Want me to draft one? I need the plan and the budget numbers from you.
4. DECIDE: A reporter (Tessa Brandt, The Larkin Dispatch) wants a quote for an "AI doomers vs. builders" piece. Also the Corvid Institute wants a sign-on to an open letter on frontier training runs. Neither is answered yet.
Everything else in the inbox is personal, so I left it alone.
